turns.you: my cat sat on my laptop

All g's. It had a point to make.
One key, held down. That's somebody insisting.

A big boy. Then the laptop is brave.
It's holding up a big boy and not saying a word.
Lucky socks. Big day, then.
Nobody wears lucky socks to a small day.
Then I hope the socks are paying attention.
What would you say?
Hey with a question mark. I'd drop the mark.
The mark makes your hey sound like it's asking permission.

turns.wink: Something slow. It's in no hurry.
Gerald. Gerald sounds patient.
You can't say Gerald in a rush. Try it.
All day. The good kind or the heavy kind?
Heavy. I'm glad you're typing now, then.
Typing means a bit of you is up.

turns.thought: A heavy day. They still reached for the keys.

turns.wink: Cereal for dinner. Very grown up.
Nobody can stop you. That's the grown up part.
Have the second bowl too. Nobody's checking.
Hate it. Too short or too long?
Too short is the better mistake.
Short, you only have to wait. Long, you'd have to go back.
Type it and I'll tell you.
Sam. Short and easy to call across a room.
Really. One sound, and you'd turn around.
Which one? Type it.
Bean. That's a nickname with a story behind it.
Really. Nobody gets called bean for no reason.

turns.you: i was tiny as a kid

turns.wink: Tiny. There's the story, then.
It's {time}.
Very sure. The time is one thing I keep exact.
Long days make the clock feel slow.

turns.wink: Pineapple. Bold. I'm on your side.
Seriously. Sweet and salty is a good fight.
Then your brother doesn't get a slice.
Twins! That's a lot of hello at once.
Are you ready to be outnumbered?
No way, and they're coming anyway.

turns.thought: Twins. Their family is about to get louder.

turns.wink: Died, or just looking tired?
Crispy. That sounds like gone, I'm afraid.
I can't see it. Crispy just sounds final.
Toast. That's my guess for everything.
Not a bit. Toast is just where I start.
A mango. Nowhere near toast.
Puddle. Say it and try not to smile.
Wobble. Same trouble.
Giggle. That one's cheating a bit.
Leftover. It sounds fine and it isn't.
Almost. That one hurts quietly.

turns.thought: Almost. A small word for a big miss.

turns.wink: You type like you mean every word.
You came back to hear it twice. I like that too.

turns.you: tell me a really short story

turns.wink: A cup fell. Nobody saw. The cup was fine.
Then the cat saw. The cup was not fine.
The cat would like it known it was an accident.

turns.thought: Two sheep was enough, it seems.

They swapped holes. Both went home happy.
Cancelled. When's the next one?
An hour, and a crowd by the sound of it.
So find a seat before they all do.

So the rest of it went fine.

turns.thought: Only the parking. They'll get it next time.
